name: The Pack Corporation
summary: The Pack Corporation, formed in 1878 with headquarters in Osaka, Japan, provides packaging solutions worldwide. Its products include several kinds of bags, among them garment, parcel, sewn, plastic and paper bags, and boxes such as trays, clear cases, plain paper boxes and corrugated shipping boxes with cushioning materials. It also supplies retail businesses with items such as shopping bags, decorative corrugated goods, paper containers, catalogs and labeling.
